newsitem.title: USA: NYC Gov proposes emergency appropriations bill.
newsitem.headline: NYC Gov proposes emergency appropriations bill.

text.p: New York State Gov George Pataki on Monday proposed emergency appropriation legislation to fund state obligations and local assistance payments from April 1 through May 9 because a budget has not been passed.
The state budget for fiscal 1998 is due at the end of the fiscal year on March 31. But lawmakers have not passed a budget yet.

The legislation calls for spending $9.9 billion, including contingency appropriations of $2.8 billion. The proposed measure inlcudes funding for school aid, Medicaid, welfare, food stamp administration and state employee payrolls.
